prompt: A cheerful clay science laboratory scene: a boy and a girl in tiny white lab coats and round goggles stand at a wooden table; a big bubbling glass flask pours colorful glowing liquid into three empty blank rounded building blocks (red, blue, yellow) that are changing shape like a magic transformation, with sparkles and little stars, a few test tubes, a gear and a lightbulb. Centered, big, friendly.

Two clay kids, a boy and a girl, standing face to face joyfully giving each other a high five between them; above each kid floats one big smooth puzzle piece (one with a tab, one with a socket) that click together perfectly in the middle with sparkles, small hearts and stars around. Bright and happy matching-pairs mood. Centered, big.

A fun clay auction house: a cheerful clay boy auctioneer in a bow tie stands behind a wooden podium holding up a big wooden gavel; in front of him four clay kids raise colorful round paddles (no writing on them); a pile of shiny gold coins and a glowing blank framed sign board on the podium; confetti. Centered, big, playful.

Two clay kids, a girl and a boy, sit at facing desks racing to write in notebooks with giant colorful pencils; between them a big golden trophy cup and a checklist board with big green check mark symbols; a small hourglass timer; motivated competitive but friendly mood. Centered, big.

Clay explorer kids in safari hats and vests on a jungle path: a girl looks through a big magnifying glass and a boy uses binoculars; colorful rounded blank word-block stones in red, blue, green, yellow, purple hang from vines and sit on the ground like treasures to discover; palm leaves and a small tent. Centered, big, adventurous.

Clay kids in yellow hard hats building a big sentence house frame: a sturdy wooden frame with exactly three big empty slots in a row, and three giant colorful clay building blocks (a blue one, a red one, a yellow one) being lifted into the slots by a girl and a boy; tools, a ladder and tiny sparkles. Centered, big, construction-fun mood.

A large clay balance scale in the center: on one pan a big round red apple stack pile sits heavily low, on the other pan one tiny small apple sits high; a cheerful clay kid champion in a medal and winner cap stands on a small gold podium next to it holding a trophy; a tall giraffe peeks in from the back and a tiny mouse sits at the bottom to show tall and short. Centered, big, playful.

Two grassy clay cliffs facing each other with a deep gap between them, and a colorful wooden plank bridge being built across: a boy and a girl on each side push big smooth glowing chain-link rings and planks into the middle to connect the two sides; a small river below, clouds and a rainbow. Centered, big, teamwork mood.

A giant clay wall calendar in the center shown as a grid of seven columns and several rows of blank rounded squares, many filled with colorful round stickers and big green check marks; next to it a clay girl holding a toothbrush, a boy with a bicycle and a stack of books, and a small round sun and moon. No numbers or letters on the calendar. Centered, big, cheerful routine mood.

A clay movie set: a clay girl director holds a big vintage movie camera on a tripod pointing at a pretty blue vase on a table, with a bright round spotlight shining on the vase; behind the vase a clay boy with a small hammer steps aside smiling; film reel, clapperboard without any writing, and stars. The vase is the star of the scene. Centered, big.

A clay adventure trail splitting into two paths at a fork: the left path goes under a gray rain cloud with raindrops where a clay girl holds a yellow umbrella, the right path goes toward a bright sunny sky with flowers where a boy holds a kite; a wooden arrow sign with no writing at the fork, a treasure map scroll and a small compass. Centered, big, adventurous.

Clay detective kids in trench coats and hats: a girl holds a big magnifying glass looking at a lineup of four clay characters standing in a row, each one wearing a different colored hat or holding something different (a red hat, a balloon, a book, an umbrella); a bright spotlight on one of them; a boy takes notes with a pencil. Centered, big, playful mystery mood.

A row of eight small clay kids standing together in two rows with different colored clothes and hats, and one of them is covered with a polka-dot cloth as a mystery; a clay boy with a big magnifying glass and a girl with her hand raised curiously ask about them; floating round bubbles above heads with simple icons only (glasses, hat, a pizza slice, a dog). Centered, big, guess-who game mood.

A cozy clay grocery market: a clay girl pushes a shopping cart full of red apples, eggs in a carton, yellow bananas, orange carrots, a milk bottle and a loaf of bread; a boy holds a paper shopping bag with a baguette; wooden shelves and crates of fruit behind them; small price-less colorful striped awning. No text. Centered, big, happy.
